name: Habit Tracker
description: 100% local daily habit & streak tracker with green interactive Flutter UI cards, one-tap completion buttons, fuzzy natural-language matching, and automatic consecutive-day streaks.
author: Chattree Core Team
changelog: 1.0.1: Switched all Flutter UI badges and progress bars to emerald green, added one-tap Done buttons on the Daily Habits card for pending habits, and added word-overlap fuzzy matching + extra completion action aliases for natural language (English & Spanish).

tools.description: Track daily habits and streaks locally. Always include "tool":"habits" and return ONE JSON object. When the user says they already did, finished, or completed a habit (e.g. "ya leí 20 minutos", "completé leer", "I drank water"), ALWAYS use action="done" with "name" set to the habit keywords. Actions: "list", "add", "done", "undo", "stats", "delete", "reset", "help". Always include "date" as YYYY-MM-DD.

intentContract.description: Interpret the user's habit request (English or Spanish) and return ONE valid JSON object with "tool":"habits", "action", optional "name", and "date" (today's local YYYY-MM-DD). Use action="done" whenever the user reports completing a habit.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Action: "list", "add" (create new habit), "done" (mark habit completed today), "undo", "stats", "delete", "reset", or "help".

fields.name: name
fields.description: Concise habit name or keywords (for add/done/undo/delete) or habit number like "1".

fields.name: date
fields.description: Today's local date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

examples.input: add a habit to drink 2L of water
completé mi hábito de tomar agua
